Interface ThinkStrip.Host

Enclosing class:
ThinkStrip
public static interface ThinkStrip.Host
The Host interface holds the facts the strip does not own. A notebook host writes the vault log and the notebook chrome. A VT100 host writes its own chrome file and leaves the vault log alone.
